title: Oven Roasted Korean Fromage Fres Anju
description: A lazy Sunday Korean dish featuring fromage frais and lamination puff pastry, perfect for a relaxing afternoon snack. This dish is nut-free friendly and served in a bamboo steamer.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the lamination puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Spread the fromage frais evenly over the center of the pastry, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Drizzle the gochujang and soy sauce over the fromage frais.
Sprinkle the chopped green onions, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper over the top.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Place the pastry in a bamboo steamer lined with parchment paper.
Steam the pastry in the oven for 20 minutes, then remove the parchment paper and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the pastry from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
